topic: Search hits' new space and tenant fields: low security-review notes
detail: SP-083 adds SearchHit.space and SearchHit.tenant, filled from the stored payload. The security review of the diff found no critical, high or medium issue. Two low notes are accepted: (1) the tenant is shown in the case it was stored (slack:TACME), while the spaces classifier matches a binding without case, so the chip may differ in case from the policy's binding; display only. (2) No client puts the new fields into an agent's prompt today (MCP rag_search, auto-RAG, CLI ignore them); if one ever does, it must quote them like the other stored fields (noted on the proto fields).
